edges.mechanism: Structural similarity to vitamin K; in vitro activation of warfarin hydroxylation (predicted ~17-32% higher clearance) may reduce anticoagulant response.
edges.evidence: Case reports of reduced warfarin response reversing on CoQ10 withdrawal; in vitro microsome data; a small randomized double-blind crossover RCT (n=24, 100 mg/day) found no INR/dose change. Flagged by NCI PDQ and NCCIH.

edges.mechanism: Statins lower circulating CoQ10 (all statins studied, lipophilic and hydrophilic); repletion proposed for statin-associated muscle symptoms.
edges.evidence: MAs of placebo-controlled RCTs consistently show statin-induced CoQ10 lowering; MAs of CoQ10 for SAMS conflict (2018 and 2025 positive, 2020 null; no effect on CK or statin adherence). NCCIH: evidence does not support use for statin muscle pain. Low certainty.

edges.mechanism: Possible additive modest systolic BP lowering.
edges.evidence: Dose-response MA: SBP -4.77 mmHg in cardiometabolic patients (moderate certainty); Cochrane found no clinically significant BP effect in primary hypertension. No direct interaction trials; theoretical.

edges.mechanism: Small fasting-glucose lowering could add to glucose-lowering therapy.
edges.evidence: NCCIH lists a possible interaction with insulin; MA of 39 RCTs shows FBG -7.33 mg/dL, HbA1c non-significant (very low certainty).

edges.mechanism: Antioxidant activity could theoretically reduce oxidative cytotoxicity of chemotherapy/radiotherapy.
edges.evidence: Observational SWOG S0221 breast cancer cohort: antioxidant use (incl. CoQ10) before and during chemo associated with higher recurrence hazard (adjHR 1.41, 0.98-2.04). NCI PDQ notes no long-term efficacy outcome data; NCCIH says it may not be compatible with some cancer treatments.

edges.mechanism: Proposed protection against anthracycline cardiotoxicity vs antioxidant-efficacy concern; no pharmacokinetic interaction detected.
edges.evidence: Phase I crossover (n=6, 300 mg/day, closed early): no clinically significant change in doxorubicin PK. NCI PDQ: small studies suggest reduced cardiotoxicity. Very low certainty.

edges.mechanism: Complementary roles in cellular redox/selenoprotein and mitochondrial function; combined repletion in selenium-deficient elderly.
edges.evidence: KiSel-10 RCT (n=443, elderly Swedes low in selenium): combined selenium + CoQ10 lowered CV mortality (5.9% vs 12.6%) and NT-proBNP over 5.2 years; 10-year follow-up suggests greater benefit in women. Single trial, combination only; low certainty.

edges.mechanism: Myocardial CoQ10 deficiency correlates with HF severity; adjunct to standard therapy.
edges.evidence: Cochrane (moderate certainty): mortality RR 0.58, HF hospitalisation RR 0.62; Q-SYMBIO MACE HR 0.50; 2024 MA mortality RR 0.64. Benefit relies largely on one trial; NCCIH considers evidence inconclusive.

edges.mechanism: Genetic CoQ10 biosynthesis defects; high-dose oral CoQ10 is the targeted replacement therapy.
Antioxidant use during cytotoxic therapy may compromise treatment efficacy.
edges.evidence: Observational association with recurrence (SWOG S0221); NCI PDQ and NCCIH caution.
